intro.title: Type form submit events
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple form that collects user input and logs it to the console upon submission. You will learn how to properly type the submit event in TypeScript to ensure type safety when handling form data. The core concept involves using the `React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>` type to define the event parameter in your submit handler function. This practice helps prevent runtime errors by leveraging TypeScript's static type checking during development.
intro.usecase: Typing form submit events is essential for building robust user interfaces in real-world applications. This pattern appears in login forms, registration pages, checkout flows, and contact forms where user input must be validated and processed securely. For example, in e-commerce dashboards, typed submit events ensure order data is correctly structured before sending to payment APIs. In admin panels, they guarantee configuration changes are properly formatted before saving to databases. Mastering this skill helps prevent runtime errors and improves data integrity across interactive web applications.
